items.title: Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration
items.content:
In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.

The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
In controlled offline evaluations, HydraFusion’s selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the evaluated Opus 5 baseline while reducing estimated workflow cost. Now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot.
The post Project HydraFusion: Frontier quality via multi-model orchestration appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: GitHub Staff

summaries.zh: GitHub 发布研究预览版 Project HydraFusion，集成于 GitHub Copilot 中，通过多模型编排实现前沿质量。在受控离线评估中，HydraFusion 的选择性编码工作流在匹配或超越 Opus 5 基准表现的同时，降低了预估工作流成本。该功能现已在 GitHub Copilot 中提供研究预览。文章来自 GitHub Blog。
summaries.en: Project HydraFusion is GitHub’s multi-model orchestration approach for coding workflows. In controlled offline evaluations, its selective coding workflows matched or exceeded the Opus 5 baseline while lowering estimated workflow costs. The feature is now available as a research preview in GitHub Copilot. The announcement was published on the GitHub Blog.

summaries.en: The GitHub Blog introduces a beginner-focused guide on using the GitHub Copilot app to run multiple agents simultaneously. The article emphasizes that mastering parallel agents transforms the user experience from feeling intimidating to feeling highly capable. Essentially, the piece positions parallel agent execution as a key skill for beginners, helping them move past initial hesitation and unlock the full potential of the tool. The post itself is an announcement for this instructional content.

items.creator: Cassidy Williams

summaries.zh: GitHub播客最近一期节目解读了开发者圈中涌现的新AI术语，包括“循环工程”（loop engineering）、“护栏/框架”（harnesses）、“小组”（squads）、“开放权重”（open weights）以及“爬山算法”（hill climbing）等。节目旨在帮助开发者理解这些在讨论AI时频繁出现的新词汇，厘清其含义与使用场景，从而更好地跟上技术对话。相关内容首发于GitHub官方博客。
summaries.en: The article highlights a GitHub Podcast episode that decodes new AI terminology appearing in developer discussions. It covers terms like loop engineering, harnesses, squads, and open weights, offering clarity on their meanings and usage. The post serves as a guide to understanding evolving AI-related jargon in the developer community.

items.title: How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality
items.content:
Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.

The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Why shorter outputs can cost more, and how GitHub Copilot reduces wasted work across the complete coding task.
The post How we make AI coding more cost efficient without sacrificing task quality appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Erik Kristensen

summaries.zh: 这篇文章探讨如何在不牺牲任务质量的前提下提升AI编程的成本效率。文中指出，较短的输出未必成本更低，有时反而更昂贵；并介绍了GitHub Copilot如何通过减少整个编码任务中的浪费工作，来提高整体效率。
summaries.en: GitHub Copilot aims to make AI coding more cost-efficient without lowering task quality. A key insight is that shorter outputs do not always mean lower costs—sometimes they can cost more. The approach focuses on reducing wasted effort across the entire coding task rather than just minimizing output length. By addressing inefficiencies throughout the workflow, GitHub Copilot improves cost effectiveness while maintaining high-quality results.

items.title: Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good.
items.content:
We built a plugin for the GitHub Accessibility Scanner to make sure your alt text is actually accessible. Here's how it works.

The post Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good. appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
We built a plugin for the GitHub Accessibility Scanner to make sure your alt text is actually accessible. Here's how it works.
The post Your alt text passes automated checks. That doesn’t mean it’s any good. appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Taarik Ashenafi

summaries.zh:
标题：你的替代文本通过了自动化检查，但这并不代表它真的好。

文章介绍：GitHub 团队为 GitHub 无障碍扫描器开发了一款插件，用于确保替代文本真正无障碍。仅靠自动化检查可能不够，需要更深入的验证。文章说明了该插件的工作原理。
summaries.en: Automated alt text checks often miss real accessibility issues. The GitHub Blog announces a new plugin for the GitHub Accessibility Scanner that aims to ensure alt text is genuinely useful, not just technically valid. The post explains how this plugin works to improve the quality of image descriptions. It highlights that passing automated checks doesn't guarantee true accessibility, and the plugin helps address that gap by providing more meaningful validation for alt text in GitHub workflows.

items.title: GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work
items.content:
If you’re juggling multiple Copilot sessions, use the My work pane to track what's in flight, what's done, and what's next.

The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
If you’re juggling multiple Copilot sessions, use the My work pane to track what's in flight, what's done, and what's next.
The post GitHub Copilot app for Beginners: Managing your work appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Christopher Harrison

summaries.zh: 该文章来自GitHub官方博客，面向初学者介绍GitHub Copilot应用中的工作管理功能。当用户同时处理多个Copilot会话时，可使用“My work”（我的工作）面板来追踪任务状态，清晰查看进行中、已完成以及下一步要处理的事项，从而更高效地管理工作流程。
summaries.en: For beginners using the GitHub Copilot app, the "My work" pane helps manage multiple Copilot sessions. It allows users to track tasks by status: what is currently in progress, what has been completed, and what still needs to be done. This feature provides a simple way to stay organized when handling several sessions at once. The tip comes from the GitHub Blog.
